% remove_dups(+List, -Result)
remove_dups([], []).
remove_dups([H|T], [H|Result]) :-
    remove_dups(T, Temp),
    not_member(H, Temp),
    Result = Temp.
remove_dups([H|T], Result) :-
    member(H, T),
    remove_dups(T, Result).

not_member(_, []).
not_member(X, [Y|Ys]) :-
    X \= Y,
    not_member(X, Ys).

% insert_sorted(+X, +Sorted, -Result)
insert_sorted(X, [], [X]).
insert_sorted(X, [H|T], [X, H|T]) :-
    X =< H.
insert_sorted(X, [H|T], [H|R]) :-
    X > H,
    insert_sorted(X, T, R).

% subset_sum(+List, +Sum, -Subset)
subset_sum(List, Sum, Subset) :-
    subset_sum_helper(List, Sum, [], Subset).

subset_sum_helper([], 0, Acc, Acc).
subset_sum_helper([], _, _, _).
subset_sum_helper([H|T], Sum, Acc, Subset) :-
    Sum >= H,
    NewSum is Sum - H,
    subset_sum_helper(T, NewSum, [H|Acc], Subset).
subset_sum_helper([_|T], Sum, Acc, Subset) :-
    subset_sum_helper(T, Sum, Acc, Subset).
